channel.title: Legend Mod — Changelog
channel.description: Release notes of Legend Mod, the browser client and extension for agar.io-style cell games: new features and fixes of every build.

item.title: v3.706 — Mod Info window, Theme options removal leftovers & Website
item.description: Mod Info window — the Templates, Manual templates, Languages and Information buttons are removed · Theme options removal leftovers — the knowledge files and llms-full.txt still described the removed HUD text size (features, modules, the Accessibility section and the settings categories), the removed game brightness / saturation (theme properties) and the… · Website — the 'use https' warning toast is removed · Nick easter eggs removed — typing EasterEgg1, EasterEgg2 or EasterEgg3 as the nick renamed you to 'Easter Egg' (or 'Video'), pressed Play and loaded a script with no off switch until a…

item.title: v3.705 — Main menu server finder, Notification centre removed & Shortcut bar
item.description: Main menu server finder — the small line under the finder row ("4 London FFA servers · counts refresh every 20 s", "Looking for London FFA servers 4/12…", "Press Scan…", "Waiting for the connection…", "Scan stopped.") is removed with its element, its CSS… · Notification centre removed — ogario/modules/notifications.js (the bell with its unread count, the list of the last 200 toasts with its filters, Mark read, Clear and the per-category mute switches), its option in Settings > HUD, its hotkey and its HUD editor… · Shortcut bar — the 'Message Script Commands' row is removed with its commands ·…

item.title: v3.704 — Profile badges removed, Replay recording & HUD
item.description: Profile badges removed — the Badges line in the profile stats (18 badges in tiers from the account stats: games, highest mass, mass consumed, time alive, level, and on Expanding Land #1 and players eaten), its badge window, the "Badge unlocked" toast and… · Replay recording — the fix for a replay token typed into the Join box only worked when a connect happened while the player was typing (the held value) · HUD — the "Show NO FOCUS when the game window is not active" switch (noFocusHud) is removed with its functionality · Settings > Zoom — "Zoom glide speed" (zoomSmooth) is removed · Bots…

item.title: v3.703 — Settings, Choose Language & Game Over card
item.description: Garix cell updates (opcode 16) with a malformed packet — every section and record is checked against the bytes left before it is read or applied · Sigmally cell updates (opcode 16) with a malformed packet — every record is checked against the bytes left before it is read or applied · Settings — the note under a setting that does not work on the connected server names that server ("Not available on this server (Senpa)") · Choose Language — the rest of the Settings tab takes the new language at once, as after a reload: the named fields (Hide chat messages containing, Snapped directions), the…

item.title: v3.702 — Phones, Legend Clan announcements & Library copies nothing loads are removed
item.description: Site pages use the same jQuery and Bootstrap as the game — the home page, the skins gallery, the clan pages (Lc/Lc.html and the Project X copy) loaded jQuery 1.11.1 from 2014, the themes page jQuery 3.2.1 with Bootstrap 3.3.7, and the old game page LMexpress/LMexpress.html jQuery 3.2.1… · Choose Language renames the Settings tab at once — its switches, sliders and section headings show the new language (they kept the language they were built in until a reload, and after a switch back to English some rows stayed in the language before) · Phones — Joystick size (50-200 %) and Joystick opacity…

item.title: v3.701 — Opponent colours and split range rings, Multibox & Bots
item.description: Opponent colours and split range rings — after a camera jump (respawn, spectating another player, switching the camera to another place) the cells at the new place get their colour and rings in the first frame · Multibox — the per-frame search for the other connection's copy of each cell (so a cell seen by two connections is drawn once) costs less: it reads the cells near it as sorted bucket columns instead of probing every bucket in a big or… · Bots — work with or without a captcha, follow the player on FFA/EXP in each bot's own map orientation, and a working Battle Royale Fill lobby · Bots…

item.title: v3.700 — Jelly physics, Cell sorting & Replay Studio
item.description: Jelly physics — changing the number of perimeter points (zooming, a cell growing or shrinking) no longer makes new arrays and point objects each time · Cell sorting — a cell list with empty slots in it keeps the time limit on its sort · Replay Studio — choosing the instant replay length in the Studio moves the knob of the Settings > Replays slider to it · Show viewports with Full Map (full spectator) open — a multibox unit also got a full spectator's box (Viewport# n, of a spectator's size around its server camera) on top of its own numbered box · Phones — the mute button of a chat popup can…

item.title: v3.699 — Performance diagnostics, Phones & Bot servers
item.description: Performance diagnostics — a packet gap (no world update) still going on when the connection closes or the server changes is listed in the events with its time up to then · Phones — the multibox button (gear panel option) shows the swap sign again once no multibox unit is left · Bot servers — fix buffer.length crash, remove unrequested orbit logic and position reporting · User Scripts — a plugin loaded again in its slot (Load once more, or an edited version) runs one copy, and its Runs at start switch stops it · User Scripts — Erase script on a slot whose plugin runs stops the plugin, as…

item.title: v3.698 — Bot integration, Bot end-to-end & Theme > Sectors X / Y
item.description: Bot integration — built-in client sends player position (opcode 11), FFA/EXP/BR mode support, shared menu background · Bot end-to-end — opcode 7/11 length guard, opcode 9 handling, Battle Royale fill-lobby button, behavioral tests · Theme > Sectors X / Y — the minimap's sector grid follows the new count at once · Theme workshop — Apply, Preview and Revert move the knobs of the Theme tab sliders to the values they set · Discover window — Esc closes it after a server type is chosen in This server and after a click or tap on its text · Expanding Land — the minimap is a circle again, with Rounded…

item.title: v3.697 — Bots
item.description: Bots — ghost-cell-based player orientation for FFA/EXP, bot position reporting for minimap · Bots — server-fast.js parity with server.js, remaining reliability fixes · LMEvents multiboxSwap is sent for every change of the multibox unit you control, from one setter (lmSetMbUnit): a focused unit dying (focus back to the main player or to the next living unit), a unit taking the focus when it… · Radial menu open while the window loses focus (Alt+Tab, a click into another window, the tab hidden): it closes without running anything

item.title: v3.696 — Settings catalog & HUD editor
item.description: Settings catalog — removed retired/dead/duplicate entries (gamepadEnabled, invertMouse, unlockedFPS, notificationCentre, duplicate transparentSkins and cellContours from Effects) · Macro feed held on a gamepad button and on a key at once — letting the key go stopped the feed while the pad button was still held · HUD editor — the Command Centre opened over it with Ctrl+K takes its own keys · While a replay plays in Replay Studio, text boxes take every key again: space, W, E, R, T, Enter and Esc, which the Studio keeps from the game, could not be typed in the Command Centre search, the chat or…

item.title: v3.695 — Settings profiles, Notification centre & Game Over card
item.description: Settings profiles — deleting a profile also drops its link to a HUD layout (the layout itself and the links of other profiles stay; a rename keeps the link) · Notification centre — the mute boxes in the panel follow LMNotifications.setMuted (also while the panel is closed, it is kept) · Game Over card — the camera icon saves the match card once per tap, as Share waits for its sheet (dimmed while the image is made) · Analytics History tab with the Match history option off — says the option is off and that played games are not added to the list, with a Turn on button (the Settings switch…

item.title: v3.694 — Custom macros window
item.description: A mouse button bound in the Hotkeys window and released over a layer that keeps mouseup from the game (the radial menu its own press opened, the Command Centre, editor windows) is released now: the radial menu on a mouse button… · Custom macros window — the first step change after renaming a macro (deleting, moving, a new count or action) was lost, made on an old copy of the macro · A HUD layout that moves the minimap away from a long leaderboard gives the leaderboard its HUD scale at once, and the normal HUD fits it again at once: it stayed small (or over the minimap) until its size changed

item.title: v3.693 — Menu footer, Notification centre & Settings profiles
item.description: Menu footer — the session line (This session: games, best mass, time played), the Match history link and the private room link take a newly chosen language at once · Notification centre — Esc closes the panel wherever the focus is · Settings profiles — renaming a profile to the name of another one gives it a numbered name (Alpha 2), as a new profile gets · Settings profiles window — Esc closes it like the other windows (with another window in front of it, that one closes first)

item.title: v3.692 — Expanding Land team chat & Bot reliability
item.description: Expanding Land team chat — the server sends a team line (opcode 202, with a clan tag or in Teams mode) to the team mates but not back to the sender, so you never saw your own team lines · Bot reliability — TLS scope, JSON guards, timer cleanup, socket lifecycle, regression tests

item.title: v3.691 — Expanding Land chat, Video skin too-long warning & Room code field
item.description: Expanding Land chat — your own public line comes back from the server under its name with no sender id, so it was handled like a stranger's line (chat sound, mute button, hide words, reported own:false to user scripts) · Video skin too-long warning — the video's address (the one the skin is played with) was compared with the raw skin field, so a link typed without https:// never got the warning, and the skin preview and the profile box both checked the same video, so a… · Room code field — codes never contain I, O, 0 or 1 (none of the four is in the code alphabet, so a look-alike cannot be…

item.title: v3.690 — Mobile UX
item.description: Mobile UX — multibox indicator, joystick response curve, zoom and free-spectate buttons

item.title: v3.689 — Smooth bot rotation & Hotkeys window
item.description: Smooth bot rotation — persistent direction and movement lerp · Hotkeys window — the key list ends where the instructions start again

item.title: v3.688 — Skin field & Chat mentions
item.description: Skin field — a skin link typed without https:// (i.imgur.com/..., an imgur page link) is saved and played as https://, but the skin preview and the profile box loaded it as a path on this site and stayed empty · Chat mentions — a chat line with your nick was marked only in the chat box · Copy leaderboard (hotkey and the leaderboard menu's copy button) and TK & ALL: the rows were copied run together ("1. Alice2. Bob3. Carl")

item.title: v3.687 — Every language but English
